There are already direct air and rail links between Moscow and Pyongyang. title: Thai August headline CPI rises 2.53% on year, above forecast
summary: BANGKOK: Thailand’s headline consumer price index rose 2.53% in August from a year earlier, following an annual rise of 1.95% in the previous month, the commerce ministry said on Monday.
